title: Apocalyptic Scythes
description: Mod that adds 6 apocalyptic scythes with unique abilities
body:
**Apocalyptic Scythes** adds 5 powerful scythes to Minecraft, each with a unique ability activated by right-clicking.

***

### Scythes

**Fire Scythe** — Summons fire structures and explosions in front of you. Grants fire resistance and slow falling after use.

**Ice Scythe** — Creates ice structures that freeze nearby enemies. Surrounds them with powder snow for extra effect.

**Soul Scythe** — Has two modes: right-click to place soul sand and soul fire traps, shift+right-click to absorb souls from nearby entities, increasing your attack damage temporarily.

**Time Scythe** — Creates a time bubble that slows all entities around you while granting you a speed boost. The bubble is visible as a temporary structure.

**Black Hole Scythe** — Creates a black hole that pulls all nearby entities toward a single point.

***

### Upgrades

All scythes can be upgraded using the **Scythe Essence**, combinable in an anvil to increase damage. The cost in levels increases with each upgrade.

A scythe can be transformed into another using the Transformer block and Scythe Essence. Useful for duplicates!

***

### Loot

Scythe Essence and scythes can be found in loot chests of specific structures, including Ancient Cities, Bastions, End Cities, Igloos, Pillager Outposts, Ruined Portals, Taiga Villages and Woodland Mansions.

***

### Updates

More content is planned — if you want updates, let me know in the comments!

***

Downloads and comments are greatly appreciated and help keep the project alive.

***

This mod **can** be used in modpacks
